description: This file defines the code-behind for an admin queue page in an online examination system. It manages session validation, database interaction for course queue checks, and navigation between different administrative pages. It also handles grid view selection events to display student answers.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Partial class for handling admin queue page functionalities in the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, verifies session variables, interacts with the database to check and modify course queues.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin queue page (likely a navigation error in naming).

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a row in the grid view is selected; stores selected student and course IDs in session variables and navigates to the answer display page.
